Leah (CS): Quick sync 1: Riptide reserved pool cutover scheduled TOMORROW 05:45 UTC. Need owners for quota confirmation, warmup, canary run, autoscale tuning, and live customer updates. Also capture any renewal feedback after first hour. Who can own live ops between 05:45-07:00?

Ben (Infra): Ill own infra handoff and reservations. Pool details: pool-id=riptide-ded-04, template=reserved-a100v4-dense, reserved_slots=5, spare=2. Will create reservation + attach slot manifest.

Diego (SE): Ill run the staged load and QA prompts. Plan: warmup 10m -> canary 10m at 8% -> ramp 30% 20m -> cut to steady. Need canary API key and KMS unseal window 05:30-06:00 UTC.

Kara (SRE): Autoscale proposal: min_replicas=2, target_util=58%, max_replicas=12, scale_up_cooldown=90s, scale_down_cooldown=240s. Use p95 latency and queue_length as signals; set p95 alert at 320ms. Add circuit-breaker: if error_rate > 1% for 2m -> shift 20% to hosted fallback and pause ramp.

Leah (CS): Customer requested a one-off warmup credit and a short post-run call for feedback. Ill log renewal note (health=watch). Please flag any UX regressions.

Ben (Infra): Reservation + warmup commands:

Ben (Infra): ```
redwoodctl reserve create --pool riptide-ded-04 --slots 5 --duration 5h --note "riptide-onramp-RES-909"
redwoodctl capacity warm --pool riptide-ded-04 --profile prime-cache --concurrency 5
```

handoff-bot: Load job scheduled: id=6355554321-load by @Diego for 2026-10-12T05:50:00Z. Load logs will post to this thread.

Diego (SE): Canary curl (token redacted at runtime):

Diego (SE): ```
curl -X POST https://riptide.api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer CANARY_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"smoke"}'
```

Kara (SRE): Fallback prepared: hosted-quantized-lite. Routing: region=us-east -> fallback=hosted-quantized-lite, max-fallback-rate=25% for first 90m. Alerts: quota@85% -> #customer-success, #eng-oncall; latency_p95@320ms -> #eng-sre.

Leah (CS): Please post 5-min perf snapshots (p50/p95/error_rate/queue) and brief customer blurb every 15m. Ill confirm the billing buffer. If KMS unseal fails DM me immediately. :white_check_mark:
